tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru mañju gho ṣa ya/ 'dir 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus te bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces ci nus kyis skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi bsgoms/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba d+dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad stong par bsam/ rang lus snang stong 'ja' tshon ltar gsal ba'i// gsang ba'i gnas nas tshangs pa'i bu ga'i bar// a wa dhū ti phyi dkar nang dmar ba// sba lcags tsam gyi yar sne las byung ba'i// sna tshogs chu skyes 'dab stong bzhad pa'i rtser// dri med mtshan mo'i mgon gyi gdan steng du// dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes sems dpa' gang*// gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen tshul bstan pa// 'jam dbyangs bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal// sku mdog gur gum gzhon nu'i lhun po la// nyi 'od bye bas 'khyud pa'i gzi byin 'bar// ngur smrig mdangs ldan chos gos rnam gsum klubs// chos 'chad phyag rgyas 'dzin pa'i ut+pa la'i// ge sar shes rab ral gri pustis mdzes// rā ga'i mdog mtshungs sa zhu'i cod pan 'chang*// zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil krung drang por bzhugs// brgyad gnyis lang tsho mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis spras// 'od phung drwa ba dkrigs pa'i klong dkyil du// bdag la dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs gsal bar gyur// gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha yi tshogs// dkon mchog rnam gsum chos srung nor lha bcas// skad cig nyid la badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ḥbaṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim// rang gi spyi mgrin snying ga'i gnas rnams su// rdo rje gsum gyi yi ges mtshan par gyur// de nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa// sangs rgyas dges pa'i tshul khrims ldan// gsung gi phrin las phun sum tshogs// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus khyab// thugs kyi dgongs pa rab zab pa// chos rnams kun gyi de nyid mkhyen// mkhas pa thams cad dga' mdzad pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la mnga'// sems can thams cad smin mdzad pa'i// phrin las mnga' ba chos kyi rje// khyod la bsu bas dpal du byed// bsten pas blo gros mchog tu 'gyur// bsten na 'jigs pa med par mdzad// bsnyen bkur bgyis pas bde ba 'byung*// de 'dra'i dpal ldan chos kyi rje// bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs// mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni// bla ma mchod pa bya'o zhes// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// de bas dngos po thams cad kyis// bla ma mnyes par byed par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan// ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob par// de srid bla ma'i zhabs drung du// 'bral ba med par gnas gyur cig /mchod pa kun gyis mchod byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu nyan pa dang*// bka' bzhin sgrub par byed par shog /ces dang*/ chos rgyal ma rnams tshig don rjes dran gyi ngang nas bton rjes/ shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan yangs shing*// 'gro kun dge legs sgrub pa'i thugs rje can// bsam yas phrin las mdzad pa'i stobs mnga' ba// 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// sh+lau ka gcig po brgya stong sogs ci 'grub 'don/ de'i tshe 'jam mgon bla ma'i rnam thar yid la dran bzhin du dad gus mos pa'i gdung shugs drag po bskyed pa gal che/

bzlas dmigs ni/ thugs ka'i zla steng dhī yig sngags 'phreng las// 'phros pa'i 'od kyis thogs med nas bsags pa'i// nad gdon sdig sgrib rmongs mun kun bsal nas// mkhyen gnyis ye shes tshad med rgyas par gyur// oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ ci nus bzlas mthar/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'jam dbyangs bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ chos rje'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ las bdud rtsi dkar dmar sngo ba'i rgyun// rim dang gcig car spros pa rang gi gnas gsum yig 'bru la thim zhing*// lus kun gang bas dbang bzhi thob cing sgo gsum dri ma cha bcas sbyangs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dngos grub thob par gyur// bla ma dam pa tshangs bug nas zhugs te// bdag lus gzhal med khang du gyur pa'i dbus// snying ga'i chu skyes zla ba'i gdan steng du// rtag tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur// ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin// shes rab sgron me dad pa spos chu'i mtsho// ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang*// bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin cing*// kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng ba yis// bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan nas// snying ga'i chu skyes thig le zla gdan la// brtan par bzhugs pa'i chos rje mchod byed cing*// nges par 'dun pa'i yid kyis gsol btab pas// 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /sa skya paṇa chen rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /tshig don rjes dran gyis mchod/ dge bsngo bkra shis sogs ji ltar 'os pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang gsum yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mchog sprul rin po che kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi thugs bzhed skong ba'i slad du shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas kun mkhyen g.yag ston mi pham chos kyi bla ma'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa snying por dril te rdzong gsar bkra shis lha rtse'i chos grwa chen por bris so//

//sarba maṅga laṃ// //de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i zhing*// sa skya paṇa chen byang chub brnyes pa'i gnas// mngon dga'i zhing du bdag cag dpon slob rnams// tshe 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /de nas bde ba can sogs sa skya pa'i// rje btsun gong ma bzhugs pa dag pa'i zhing*// mang du bsgrod nas spangs rtogs myur rdzogs nas// sprul pa'i sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /bstan pa'i bdag po dpal ldan sa skya pa// gangs ri'i khrod du theg chen chos sgra sgrogs// 'khor lo'i sgyur rgyal kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i bkra shis shog/ //dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
